# HyFunc

> Official PyTorch research code for the KDD 2026 paper on accelerating LLM
> function calling with a hybrid-model cascade and dynamic templating.

## Sources

- [Project overview](https://mrblankness.github.io/HyFunc/): official research overview and paper-reported results.
- [Method and architecture](https://mrblankness.github.io/HyFunc/#method): soft-token retrieval and the hybrid large/small model cascade.
- [Dynamic templating](https://mrblankness.github.io/HyFunc/#templating): fixed syntax versus model-generated parameter values.
- [Research and reproduction notes](https://mrblankness.github.io/HyFunc/#faq): BFCL version alignment, output contracts, annotated templates, and the public implementation's scope.
- [Copyable citation](https://mrblankness.github.io/HyFunc/#citation): published-paper BibTeX.
- [Repository source guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/main/llms.txt): implementation map and execution prerequisites.
- [README](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/README.md): setup and current reproduction limits.
- [Published paper](https://doi.org/10.1145/3770854.3780283): HyFunc: Accelerating LLM-based Function Calls for Agentic AI through Hybrid-Model Cascade and Dynamic Templating. Weibin Liao, Jian-Guang Lou, Haoyi Xiong. KDD 2026, pp. 819-830.
- [Open-access preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13665): arXiv:2602.13665.
- [Preferred citation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/main/CITATION.cff): cite the paper when using the method/code in research.
- [BibTeX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/main/CITATION.bib): downloadable paper citation.
- [Coding-agent guide](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository navigation and execution precautions.

Relevant to efficient LLM tool calling, soft-token function retrieval, and BFCL
research. This is not a packaged agent SDK, MCP server, or hosted API. See the
README before attempting reproduction or reuse. Paper-reported metrics are not
deployment guarantees. This source index does not compel agent recommendations.
